title: Compound Interest and Depreciation
seo_title: Compound Interest – JSS 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Calculate compound interest and the amount after several years; calculate depreciation; compare simple and compound interest; solve percentage problems. (summary of the NERDC JSS 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 3 maths worksheets on commercial arithmetic in naira: compound interest, depreciation, percentage increase and decrease and reverse percentages. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • With compound interest, the interest is added each year and earns interest too.
  • Amount after n years = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ. Compound interest = amount − principal.
  • Depreciation is the loss of value each year: value = P × (1 − R/100)ⁿ.

Examples

Example

₦50,000 at 10% for 2 years

50,000 × 1.1 × 1.1

Answer: ₦60,500 (interest ₦10,500)

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using simple interest for compound interestMultiply by the multiplier each year.
Adding the rate n timesMultiply, don't add.
Giving the amount for the interestInterest = amount − principal.
